criteria.title: Task framing
criteria.description: The ML task is correctly identified, the target named, and regression vs classification correctly chosen and justified.

criteria.title: Data preparation & leakage control
criteria.description: Cleaning and encoding appropriate. Split made before any fitting. Pipeline used. No leakage present - a leak found by the marker caps this criterion at zero.

criteria.title: Modelling protocol
criteria.description: At least two models built and compared under identical conditions. Baseline included. Hyperparameters handled sensibly.

criteria.title: Evaluation & metric justification
criteria.description: Correct metrics computed. Metric choice defended against the cost of error. Cross-validation reported with a spread, not a single number.

criteria.title: Engineering interpretation & limits
criteria.description: The result is stated in physical or operational units. Three genuine limitations given. A clear position on whether it should be deployed.

criteria.title: Code clarity
criteria.description: Runs top to bottom. Readable. Commented where the intent is not obvious.
